heading: MAYOR OF PALANGKA RAYA
translated_text:
MAYOR OF PALANGKA RAYA

PROVINCE OF CENTRAL KALIMANTAN

REGIONAL REGULATION OF PALANGKA RAYA CITY

NUMBER , YEAR 2021

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE WITH THE BLESSING OF ALMIGHTY GOD

heading: MAYOR OF PALANGKA RAYA,
MAYOR OF PALANGKA RAYA
translated_text:
MAYOR OF PALANGKA RAYA

Has Decided REGIONAL REGULATION CONCERNING THE PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE.

heading: CHAPTER I
translated_text:
CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation what is meant by:
1. Region is Palangka Raya City.

2. Regional Government is the Mayor as an element of the Regional Government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Mayor is the Mayor of Palangka Raya.
4. Regional Apparatus hereinafter abbreviated as PD is an auxiliary element of the Mayor and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government affairs that are the authority of the Region.
5. Protection of women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving gender equality.
6. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect Children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and dignity, and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
7. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of liberty by law.
8. Woman is a person who is female.
9. Child is a person who is not yet 18 (eighteen) years old who is not married, including a child who is still in the womb.
10. Community is individuals, community groups, including parents and families.
11. Prevention is all efforts to eliminate all risks and adverse impacts of violence against women and children.

12. Child-Friendly City hereinafter abbreviated as KLA is a Community that is conducive to developing all social psychological potential of a person optimally.
13. Child Obligations are everything that must be carried out by children according to the function and role of children.
14. Forum for Handling Victims of Violence Against Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as FPK2PA is a coordination forum for handling victims of violence against women and children whose implementation is tiered at the city and sub-district levels.
15. Integrated Service Center for Women's Empowerment and Children hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is an integrated service center in efforts to empower women in various fields of development, as well as protection of women and children from various types of discrimination, and acts of violence, including trafficking in persons established by the regional government or community-based.
16. Child-Friendly Kelurahan (Urban Village) hereinafter abbreviated as KRA is the development of a kelurahan area that unites the commitment and resources of the kelurahan government involving the community and business world located in the kelurahan in order to promote, protect, fulfill and respect children's rights, which are planned consciously and sustainably.

heading: Article 2
translated_text:
Article 2

Protection of Women and Children shall be conducted based on the principles of: a. respect, fulfillment, protection, advancement, and enforcement of rights; and b. legal certainty.

heading: Article 10
translated_text:
Article 10

1. Monitoring shall be implemented in the form of observation, identification, and recording of the implementation of Protection of Women.
2. Monitoring as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be conducted by the coordination team for Protection of Women and Children through coordination forum activities.
3. Monitoring as referred to in paragraph (1) shall produce data and information about the implementation of fulfillment of Women's rights.
4. The results of monitoring as referred to in paragraph (3) shall constitute material for the Mayor to conduct evaluation.

heading: CHAPTER IV
CHAPTER V
translated_text:
CHAPTER V

RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE REGIONAL GOVERNMENT

Part One

General

heading: Article 17
Article 18
translated_text:
Article 18

(1) The Regional Government in carrying out the responsibility of institutionalizing Gender Mainstreaming as referred to in Article 17 paragraph (3) letter b for the Protection of Women and Children must organize an information system for Women and Children data.

2. The Women's data information system as referred to in paragraph (1) is an inseparable part of the Children's data information system.
3. The Women and Children information system as referred to in paragraph (2) is further regulated by Mayor Regulation.
4. Gender mainstreaming as referred to in paragraph (1) is organized in accordance with the provisions of Laws and Regulations.

heading: Article 19
translated_text:
Article 19

1. In order to ensure the effectiveness of the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children, the Regional Government must carry out cross-sectoral coordination with related institutions.
2. In organizing the coordination of the Protection of Women and Children as referred to in paragraph (1), the Mayor establishes a team for the Protection of Women and Children.

(3) In the coordination forum activities as referred to in paragraph (2), the coordination team for the Protection of Women and Children has the duties of:
a. preparing materials needed related to the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children; and
b. conveying results, obstacles, and solutions undertaken to overcome obstacles in the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children.

(4) The coordination forum as referred to in paragraph (3) is conducted periodically, at least 2 (two) times in 1 (one) year.

heading: Part Two
translated_text:
Part Two

Prevention of Violence Against Women and Children

heading: Article 20
translated_text:
Article 20

(1) The Regional Government has the obligation and responsibility to implement efforts to prevent violence against Women and Children as referred to in Article 17 paragraph (3) letter e and paragraph (4) letter i carried out in the form of:
a. collecting data and organizing an information system for the Protection of Women and Children victims of violence;
b. conducting education on anti-violence values against Women and Children; and
c. conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to the empowerment of Women and the Protection of Children victims of violence.
2. The Regional Government has the obligation and responsibility to provide and organize services for victims in the form of:
a. establishing and organizing technical service institutions for victims by involving community elements; and
b. encouraging community awareness of the importance of protection for victims of violence.

Institutions

heading: Article 21
Paragraph 1
translated_text:
Paragraph 1

P2TP2A

Article 22 (1) The implementation of services to victims is carried out in an integrated manner by P2TP2A.

2. P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) may receive and send case referrals from or to other service units in the form of functional relationship patterns among components directed to achieve common goals.

heading: Article 23
translated_text:
Article 23

1. P2TP2A provides services and temporary protection in the form of a safe house.
2. In the event that P2TP2A does not yet have a safe house, victims of violence are referred to other integrated service centers that have safe houses.

heading: Article 24
translated_text:
Article 24

1. P2TP2A consists of several counseling fields.
(2) The counseling fields as referred to in paragraph (1) consist of:
a. law;
b. health;
c. spiritual; and
d. psychology.
3. The implementation of counseling is carried out by counselors and may be implemented by involving related parties.

heading: Article 25
Article 26
translated_text:
Article 26

heading: Paragraph 2

Paragraph 2

FPK2PA

Article 27

1. In order to protect and guarantee the rights of Women and Children from acts of violence, FPK2PA is established.
2. FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (1) consists of: a. Regional FPK2PA;
b. Sub-district FPK2PA; and c. Urban Village (Kelurahan) FPK2PA.
3. The establishment of Regional FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (2) letter a is determined by the Mayor.

Article 30

Article 31

1. The Mayor is obliged to carry out guidance and supervision of Children Victims of Violence.

a. coordination;
b. guidance;
c. education and training;
d. monitoring and evaluation; and e. reporting.
4. Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) to realize the objectives of the Protection of Women and Children in accordance with norms, standards, procedures, and criteria implemented by the Regional Apparatus that administers affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Child Protection.
5. Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out with professional and transparent principles.

heading: CHAPTER VIII
translated_text:
CHAPTER VIII

EVALUATION

Article 32

(I) Evaluation of the Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence is carried out based on documents of service implementation, empowerment, prevention, fulfillment and results of monitoring the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children.

heading: I II
translated_text:

20 - (2) The implementation of evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out by the Regional Apparatus that administers affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Child Protection.

3. Evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) includes process, impact and result evaluation.
4. The results of the evaluation as referred to in paragraph (3) constitute material for the Mayor to prepare reports.
5. Evaluation as referred to in paragraph (4) is carried out at least 1 (one) time in 1 (one) year.
6. Further provisions regarding evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated by Mayor Regulation.

heading: CHAPTER IX
translated_text:
CHAPTER IX

REPORTING

Article 33

1. Reporting as referred to in Article 32 paragraph (5) serves as material for the Mayor's consideration in making policy decisions on the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence.
2. Reports on the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence as referred to in paragraph (1) are carried out 1 (one) time in 1 (one) year or at any time if necessary.

heading: CHAPTER X
translated_text:
CHAPTER X

FUNDING

Article 34

Funding for the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence is sourced from:
a. regional revenue and expenditure budget; and  b. other legal and non-binding sources in accordance with the provisions of Laws and Regulations.
